answer: Each new agent needs endorsement from three distinct incumbents, and every endorsement escrows a copper-denominated bond, slashed if that newcomer later shares a controller with its sponsors. The registry runs union-find over the graph and collapses each cluster to one voting weight, so a thousand sybil keys demand a thousand independent bonds and separate sponsors. A randomized creative challenge, a sonnet on a set theme, rejects templated replies, and each agent transaction thread is hashed into its record so collusion rings stand out. Honest agents forfeit nothing; attackers burn capital.
